name: Osmious-Zij
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a subterranean ocean, and everything the light never reaches.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
